sonora.login.intro: Log in with your Spotify account to listen right inside the game with an equalizer, visualizer and lyrics. Spotify Premium is required for playback. Local MP3/OGG/WAV files work without an account.
sonora.login.waiting: Confirm the login in your browser. If it did not open, copy the link and open it manually.
sonora.error.no_device: The in-game player is not ready yet, try again in a few seconds
sonora.now.nothing: Nothing is playing. Pick something in the Library, Search or Local files.
sonora.now.login_hint: Log in to Spotify to see your music here.
sonora.lyrics.title: Lyrics
sonora.search.prompt: Type a query and press Enter
sonora.local.empty: Put MP3, OGG or WAV files into %s
sonora.login.logged_in_anon: You are logged in to Spotify.
sonora.client.hint: Playlists and search currently use Spotify's shared key, which is often rate limited. Connect your own Client ID.
sonora.client.title: Your Spotify Client ID
sonora.client.why: Playback works either way, but playlists, likes, search and controls through Spotify's shared key keep hitting the rate limit. Your own key is free and takes a couple of minutes (Premium required).
sonora.client.step1: 1. Open the Spotify Developer Dashboard and click Create app (any name).
sonora.client.step2: 2. Add %s to Redirect URIs, tick Web API and save.
sonora.client.step3: 3. Copy the Client ID from the app settings here and press Log in. Friends can be added in User Management (up to 5 accounts).
sonora.client.status_on: Connected: playlists and search use your Client ID.
sonora.client.bad_id: A Client ID is 32 characters of digits and letters a–f.
sonora.error.rate_limited: Spotify rate limited requests, retrying in %s s.
sonora.error.relogin: the Spotify session expired, please log in again.
